title: Joint Space Motion Model
text: Model rigid body tree motion given joint-space inputs, 4 inputs, 3 outputs, {Initial joint configuration} sets Initial joint positions; {Rigid body tree} sets the robot model, {Motion Type} sets the type of motion computed by motion model Computed Torque, {Specification format} sets the inputs to control robot Damping Ratio / Natural, {Damping ratio}, {Natural frequency}, {Settling time} sets the tling time of system, {Overshoot} sets the system overshoot, {Proportional gain}, {Derivative gain}, {Show external force input} displays FExt port, {Initial joint velocities} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: FExt
ports.summary: External forces acting on system 6-by- m matrix

params.name: Motion Type
params.values: Type of motion computed by motion model Computed Torque Control (default) | Independent Joint Motion | PD Control | Open Loop Dynamics

params.name: Specification format
params.values: Inputs to control robot Damping Ratio / Natural Frequency (default) | Step Response

params.name: Damping ratio
params.values: Damping ratio of system 1 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Natural frequency
params.values: Natural frequency of system 10 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Settling time
params.values: Settling time of system 0.59 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Proportional gain for PD Control 100 (default) | n -by- n matrix | scalar

params.name: Derivative gain
params.values: Derivative gain for PD control 10 (default) | n -by- n matrix | scalar

params.name: Initial joint configuration
params.values: Initial joint positions 0 (default) | n -element vector | scalar

params.name: Initial joint velocities
params.values: Initial joint velocities 0 (default) | n -element vector | scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
